experiment: X7 per-unique-object models from the best views (fx/x7-object-models)

rules.clock: t0 = the core's hand-off in the model container's memory; each model: its held-out gate decided and GLB written
rules.held_out_gate: build_lingbot_object_model.evaluate on a view never used to generate or place: IoU >= 0.65, rel. depth median <= 0.04, p95 <= 0.10, and its 300-px floor (640x480 clip raster) as the same source-frame area on the DA3 grid 504x280 = 103 px
rules.views: good views >= 15 deg apart (arm sep15, the spec) or >= 5 deg (arm sep5, sensitivity), up to 4 generate + 1 held out

timing_model.note: both generators run at once on both GPUs; each alone would get more of the GPUs (not measured)

core_reused.branch: fb/a-core (+ masks_lr hand-off, dump after the clock)
